mapper.select: SELECT id, course_id AS courseId, teacher_id AS teacherId, token, status, create_time AS createTime, expire_time AS expireTime FROM digital_tokens WHERE course_id = #{courseId} AND status = 'active' AND expire_time > NOW() ORDER BY create_time DESC LIMIT 1
